name: Missing In Action
summary: In the Redridge Mountains, Corporal Keeshan is missing after his regiment was overrun. Blackrock orcs knocked him unconscious and dragged him into a cave fortress. Now he needs an escort back to Lakeshire, where the garrison can learn what became of the missing men.

sections.title: A Regiment Overrun
sections.body: Blackrock orcs descend from the northern peaks, making the Redridge Mountains more perilous. Town guard patrols often meet ambushes, and Corporal Keeshan's unit suffered the worst of them. The regiment was outnumbered and overwhelmed, and most of its soldiers fell in the attack. Keeshan survived when a crushing blow knocked him unconscious before the orcs could execute him. They dragged him to their cave as a prisoner.

sections.title: Escape from the Caves
sections.body: Battered and concussed, Keeshan is held deep in enemy territory and cannot make the trek down the mountain alone. You escort him toward Lakeshire, past the orc warbands occupying the ridgelines. Marshal Marris has been trying to learn what happened to the missing regiment while preparing Lakeshire for further attacks. Keeshan's safe return brings him sorely needed relief.

faq.answer: Corporal Keeshan is an Alliance infantryman stationed in the Redridge Mountains. Blackrock orcs overwhelmed his regiment during a patrol in the rocky hills, then dragged him away. He is the only known survivor.
Corporal Keeshan is held deep inside an orc-infested cave in Redridge's northern hills, surrounded by hostile Blackrock warriors.

faq.q: What happened to the rest of Keeshan's unit?
faq.answer: Blackrock orcs ambushed and overpowered Keeshan's regiment. Nearly all the men died in the first skirmish.

faq.q: Who sends players to rescue Keeshan?
aliases: where to pick up missing in action
faq.answer: Corporal Keeshan sends you to free him from his prison cave, where Alliance adventurers discover him.

faq.q: Where does Keeshan go after being freed?
faq.answer: After you free him, Keeshan needs an escort down the mountainside to Lakeshire. He reports to Marshal Marris near the town's bridge.

faq.q: Why are the Blackrock orcs in Redridge?
faq.answer: The Blackrock clan pushes south from its strongholds in the Burning Steppes into Redridge. The clan threatens Lakeshire, which is poorly reinforced, and ambushes Kingdom patrols.

angles.text: As an Alliance soldier, every rescued fighter matters to Lakeshire's strained garrison as it defends the Kingdom against the Blackrock clan.
As a warrior, you hold the frontline against waves of Blackrock attackers while protecting the concussed Keeshan during his escape from their armed camp.
